authorized_by: main lane, after the 60-source Stage 0 census passed
state_verification: modal app list --json, checked after launch rather than assumed
why_no_wrapper: --detach did not survive client-side DNS failures twice on this project; a client-side timeout would add a second way to lose the run. Durability is structural instead.
hardware: CPU only, cpu=8.0, OMP_NUM_THREADS=4, memory 16 GiB
shortlist_note: K=8 unchanged. Main declined the shortlist-4 variant: the ~$9 saving is a cost consideration, not a scientific one, and narrowing the lookahead right after establishing the task has genuine geometry would undercut the reason the smoke exists.

durability.contrast_with_census: scripts/pareto_tradeoff_census.py held 75 minutes in memory and wrote once at the end; that pattern is deliberately not repeated here.

questions_this_smoke_must_answer: Do requested preferences yield distinct CLOSED-LOOP molecular outcomes, not merely distinct one-step choices?
Does greedy preference control beat unguided and generate-then-rank meaningfully?
Is there headroom for verified future-aware control over greedy?
Are hypervolume and coverage away from ceilings and floors?
Are oracle and kernel budgets reported honestly under all counters?
Does anything collapse from candidate-set size or computational mechanics?
framing: Instrument work, not a paper result.

reporting_rules.no_arm_is_globally_budget_matched: With a ~600-successor fiber there is no single notion of matched compute. Pareto quality is reported against BOTH unique valid oracle evaluations AND kernel/reference-process calls, with each arm's position on both stated.
reporting_rules.gen_rank_is_one_sided: Only the kernel-matched end of the P3/P4 bracket is affordable. A kernel-matched generate-then-rank may be vastly oracle-richer than the closed-loop arms; that makes it a strong baseline IN ONE RESOURCE DIMENSION and it must be described that way, never as globally budget matched.
reporting_rules.no_pvalue_for_guaranteed_signs: verified >= greedy follows from policy improvement; magnitude only.

retrieve_shards.note: The analysis runs the instrument gate on the shards BEFORE computing any contrast, and on failure writes INVALID_INSTRUMENT with no numbers at all.

potency_watch.status: WATCH ONLY -- no threshold is moved

the_two_numbers_and_which_line_each_face.G3_binding_share_0.76: potency was the binding Chebyshev term in 76% of (state, preference) decisions, against the G3 rejection line of 0.90
the_two_numbers_and_which_line_each_face.G4_potency_reach_0.700: 14 of 20 sources reached the held-in p99 within six greedy edits, against the G4 rejection line of 0.85

potency_watch.binding_rule: The lines stay exactly where they were frozen at d206d55. Tightening the task now because a passing number feels close to its line is moving a line after seeing the census, which is the thing the preregistration exists to prevent.
checks_in_this_smoke: Do extreme preference weights (w=0.1 vs w=0.9) produce different ENDPOINTS, not merely different one-step choices?
Does the potency-heavy side stop moving early?
Does one objective dominate most final Pareto points?
Do final preference selections stay differentiated?
Does HV stop improving because potency effectively saturates?
potency_watch.acceptable_outcome: If these come back badly the smoke can legitimately FAIL the Pareto experiment despite Stage 0 passing. That is an acceptable outcome and will be reported as a failure, not repaired.
